entries.reason: Changed-line lint rejects new ambiguous operation bools and lastError channels; predicates remain valid bool APIs.
evidence: docs/dev/Result检查与不得丢弃返回值规范.md
entries.result_policy: Operation outcomes use Result<T> or a named status enum; predicates may return bool.
entries.nodiscard_policy: Critical handles, subscriptions, scopes and operation Results are [[nodiscard]].
entries.pointer_policy: A public pointer requires Doxygen ownership/lifetime wording or an explicit reviewed adapter contract.

entries.reason: Physics links are process-local projections and must be stale-safe across either destruction order and restore.
evidence: docs/dev/物理系统分层与后端契约.md
entries.ownership: World owns bodies, shapes and joints; gameplay stores only the typed link projection.
entries.destroy_order: Shape/Joint before Body/World and World before dependants both invalidate to StaleHandle.
entries.restore: Rebuild process-local links from persistent identity after transactional world restore or hot reload.
entries.stale: Generation and owner identity are checked by resolve; encoded validity alone is insufficient.

entries.reason: Detached fragment bitmaps need process-local source identity without becoming a second mutable terrain authority.
entries.create: PixelWorld stamps a world id and epoch into every atomically detached PixelFragment.
entries.ownership: PixelWorld solely owns live terrain; a fragment owns only its detached bitmap and a non-owning source link.
entries.destroy_order: Fragment destruction is independent; world destruction makes rasterization impossible without dereferencing retained world pointers.
entries.restore: Transactional restore and clear increment the world epoch; callers must discard or explicitly recreate stale physics projections.
entries.stale: Rasterization compares both runtime world identity and epoch and returns StaleHandle before any terrain write.

entries.owner: RTS ECS world and registered RTS services
entries.reason: RTS cross-domain links distinguish ECS generation handles from service keys and rebuild after restore.
evidence: docs/dev/领域短根继承与跨域组合架构.md
entries.create: EntityLink::bind and ServiceLink::bind return checked links.
entries.ownership: The ECS world or capability registry owns the target; a link never claims target ownership.
entries.destroy_order: Target destruction invalidates generation links; service unregister invalidates key links.
entries.restore: Entity links rebuild from entity identity and service links rebind by stable logical key.
entries.stale: Entity generation and service presence are checked before use.

entries.owner: scene node owner plus target-module provider
entries.reason: Scene link dispatch stays module-neutral and drops dead targets through provider-owned liveness checks.
entries.create: The target module registers LinkOps and the scene stores a typed-kind projection.
entries.ownership: Scene owns link records; the provider owns the target object and callback table.
entries.destroy_order: Target teardown unregisters or reports dead before scene link dispatch; scene teardown drops records.
entries.restore: Provider re-registers operations and scene rebuilds link records from persistent node identity.
entries.stale: alive callback is consulted before push/pull; an absent operation id is not dereferenced.

entries.reason: Tactics membership distinguishes process-local ECS generations from persisted SubjectRef identities.
entries.create: Tactics facade validates battle/side membership before assigning ECS handles; script sessions are allocated through RuntimeObjectRegistry.
entries.ownership: The ECS world owns entities, Tactics owns aggregate destruction responsibility, and scripts own only a generation/epoch proxy.
entries.destroy_order: Units release before sides and battles; either proxy-first or module-first destruction observes generations before release.
entries.restore: Snapshot restore resolves persisted SubjectRef identities against live target entities and never serializes ECS/runtime handles.
entries.stale: Every ECS use calls ecs::try_get and every script call resolves RuntimeHandleRef generation plus module owner epoch.

entries.reason: Every mutable fact has one owner; adapters, snapshots and links are explicitly non-authoritative projections.
evidence: docs/dev/重构代码质量与系统完整性规范.md
entries.state: Mutable runtime state, persistent snapshot state and cached projections are named separately.
entries.authoritative_owner: The domain registry/container/world named by the contract is the sole writer of the fact.
entries.projections: Links, handles, ECS views and UI/script values are invalidatable projections and cannot become a second store.

entries.reason: Climbing input and selection publish their deterministic access and commit contracts before ECS integration.
entries.entity_scope: characters carrying a ClimbingIntent and an owner-qualified ClimbingRuntime
entries.view: generation-checked character view; Physics is borrowed synchronously during candidate preparation
entries.read_set: ClimbingPose, ClimbingProfileDefinition, ClimbingIntent, ClimbingAnchorGraphDefinition and Physics world geometry
entries.write_set: ClimbingIntent consumption evidence, ClimbingRuntime execution state, and claim-generation-protected graph occupancy reservations only at transaction commit or atomic restore
entries.structural_changes: none; entity/component creation and removal remain the caller's deferred responsibility
entries.events: Started/anchor-transition/contact/terminal facts enter the runtime-owned bounded queue only after authoritative mutation; drain detaches the batch before any callback or script runs
entries.services: injected SimulationTick, last grounded tick and borrowed owner-thread Physics World3D
entries.phase: input buffering in Input; candidate preparation and atomic selection in PrePhysics

entries.reason: Inventory mutations and prepared batches publish their access, commit and observer contracts even though Bags are domain containers rather than ECS entities.
entries.entity_scope: caller-owned Bag and EquipmentSet domain containers; no ECS entity traversal
entries.view: one owning-thread Bag snapshot captured during preparation and compared in full before commit
entries.read_set: item definitions, Bag configuration, filters, capacity and stack policies, slots and custom properties
entries.write_set: the target Bag slot vector plus the inventory event queue after successful commit
entries.structural_changes: prepared additions mutate only a private candidate; commit swaps the target slot vector once and never changes ECS structure
entries.events: inventory change hooks and poll events publish only after the authoritative slot swap; failed and stale batches publish nothing
entries.services: process-local item registry and named inventory policies on the Bag owning simulation thread
entries.phase: gameplay transaction commit after validation and before downstream inventory presentation polling

entries.reason: NPC AI ECS projection publishes its access contract and closes each view before authoritative world evaluation.
entries.entity_scope: live ECS entities carrying NpcAgentState and optionally NpcAiProjection
entries.view: generation-checked NpcAgentState view for preflight followed by a separate NpcAiProjection view after authoritative evaluation
entries.read_set: NpcAgentState link and NpcAiWorld generation state
entries.write_set: NpcAiProjection presentation cache only; NpcAiWorld remains the sole authoritative behavior-state owner
entries.structural_changes: none while views are open; agent creation and release are explicit caller-owned operations
entries.events: signals and transition trace remain in NpcAiWorld and are not dispatched while an ECS view is open
entries.services: borrowed owner-thread NpcAiWorld plus injected SimulationStep tick and dt
entries.phase: deterministic AI simulation phase after perception ingestion and before animation/presentation consumption

entries.reason: PixelWorld worker scheduling must declare immutable phase reads, isolated candidate writes and canonical commit ordering.
entries.entity_scope: canonical active PixelWorld Chunk indices for one injected SimulationTick
entries.view: immutable post-movement PixelCell phase state plus one owning candidate slot per Chunk index
entries.read_set: PixelCell material and temperature, immutable MaterialCatalog definitions and canonical Chunk order
entries.write_set: index-owned ThermalContribution buffers and transfer counters only; workers never write PixelWorld
entries.structural_changes: none on workers; owner thread performs sorted temperature commits and later Chunk tombstone publication
entries.events: StepStats parallelTasks and deterministic phase counters after synchronous join
entries.phase: thermal candidate generation after canonical movement and before owner-thread thermal commit

entries.reason: RPG systems publish access contracts; none mutate ECS structure and each names its owning component and thread.
entries.entity_scope: RPGActor ECS entities registered by RPGActor::createActor / liveActors()
entries.view: no View traversal that mutates while iterated; systems read actor components and run on liveActors()
entries.read_set: Attributes, Statuses, Skills, Progression, Vitals, Traits and ClassInfo components as applicable
entries.write_set: the system's owning component (Vitals/Progression/Traits/ClassInfo/Skills) and event queues only
entries.structural_changes: no structural ECS mutation from within update; actor destruction is explicit and deferred by callers
entries.events: status tick/change, cast, vitals, level-up and battle events polled after update
entries.services: injected dt/turn time and named seed streams; no global mutable time or wall clock
entries.phase: script/game-driven simulation; Battle is turn-based, others are update(dt)-driven

entries.reason: RTS systems publish machine-readable access contracts before view iteration and deferred structural changes.
entries.entity_scope: live Unit, Building, ResourceNode, Faction and Match ECS roots in the current world
entries.view: typed generation-checked RTS views; each view closes before deferred creation, destruction or relationship repair
entries.read_set: identity, faction links, motion, orders, production, effects, research definitions, match rules and economy queries as applicable
entries.write_set: motion, orders, lifecycle projections, production queues, faction research state, match participant/state/event components and affected surrender roots
entries.structural_changes: unit production and surrender collect stable handles during traversal, then create or destroy only after the relevant view closes
entries.events: ordered command, production, effect, technology unlock, surrender and victory lifecycle facts are emitted after authoritative mutation
entries.services: injected SimulationStep, definition registry, action executor, resource query and capability services; callbacks are synchronous and not retained
entries.phase: owner-thread deterministic simulation after command ingestion and before presentation; match evaluation follows authoritative economy settlement

entries.reason: Tactics phase systems publish their access contract before operating on battle, side and unit roots.
entries.entity_scope: Battle, TacticalSide and TacticalUnit roots linked to the supplied module-owned battle
entries.view: generation-checked battle membership handles; systems perform no structural mutation during ECS view traversal
entries.read_set: identity, membership, turn resources and board cell/occupancy facts
entries.write_set: battle revision/turn/events/commands/objectives/reactions/board and tactical unit membership, position, resources and alive state
entries.structural_changes: none inside BattleSystem; Tactics facade creates candidates before checked registration and destroys rejected candidates
entries.events: battle, round, turn, action, reaction, defeat and objective transitions appended in deterministic sequence order
entries.services: injected SimulationStep and the shared ActionRuntime effect-executor contract; no required rendering provider
entries.phase: owner simulation thread after setup/command ingestion and before presentation

entries.reason: Simulation code receives typed time and named random streams; wall clock access is kept at adapters.
evidence: docs/dev/重构代码质量与系统完整性规范.md
entries.time_source: SimulationStep/SimulationTick supplied by the scheduler; wall clock is not read by deterministic systems.
entries.rng_stream: named seed/stream is supplied by the owning simulation context and is not global mutable state.
entries.determinism: same inputs, tick and named streams produce replay/lockstep-identical results where declared deterministic.
entries.tolerance: backend or floating-point paths declare an explicit tolerance rather than silently claiming bit identity.

entries.reason: Public pointer and callback APIs must state ownership, lifetime, affinity and reentrancy in Doxygen.
evidence: docs/dev/重构代码质量与系统完整性规范.md
entries.thread_affinity: each public API names caller/owner thread or explicitly states thread-safe access.
entries.reentrancy: callbacks and script calls state whether reentrant and are not invoked while a mutex is held.
entries.ownership_contract: owned, borrowed, observer and transferred values are explicit.
entries.lifetime: borrowed values are bounded by the documented call/frame/task lifetime; handles are stale-safe.
entries.lock_callback_policy: release internal locks before invoking unknown callbacks or scripts.

entries.reason: Persistent formats are versioned and restore is candidate-first so failures do not publish partial state.
entries.schema: stable logical schema id and content hash identify the payload.
entries.version: SchemaVersion and snapshot revision/tick are distinct typed fields.
entries.migration: known older versions migrate into a local candidate before validation and commit.
entries.unknown_fields: unknown fields follow the schema's explicit reject, preserve or ignore policy.
entries.restore_atomicity: parse, validate and migrate locally; publish once; failure leaves the observable owner unchanged.

entries.reason: Battle snapshots and accepted command logs are deterministic inputs for save, replay and divergence diagnosis.
entries.schema: SnapshotEnvelope type tactics.battle with LogicalId schema tactics:battle.
entries.version: SchemaVersion 1; battle Revision and SimulationTick remain separate typed envelope fields.
entries.migration: There is no older released tactics schema; version 1 is exact and newer/unknown versions are rejected until an explicit migration is registered.
entries.unknown_fields: Envelope and tactics payload objects reject unknown or missing fields; arrays validate every owning record.
entries.restore_atomicity: Hash, identity, version, complete payload, links and invariants are validated in a local Candidate before one commit to battle/components.

entries.reason: Capability absence is a tested state, not an implicit soft skip; fallback behavior is observable and classified.
entries.present_test: provider-present profile builds and runs the capability probe.
entries.absent_test: provider-absent profile builds and runs the explicit absence probe.
entries.fallback_observable: fallback status/diagnostic is exposed to the caller and is not a silent success.
entries.fallback_policy: fallbacks are named, classified and tracked by the bounded quality-debt metadata gate.

entries.reason: CPU/GPU and provider implementations share observable contracts and inject failures at lifecycle boundaries.
evidence: docs/dev/物理系统分层与后端契约.md
entries.contract: provider implementations expose the same Result/status, ownership, determinism and failure semantics.
entries.providers: CPU reference plus production GPU/Vulkan/WebGPU providers where the profile supplies them.
entries.shared_contract_tests: the same lifecycle and parity assertions run against each available provider.
entries.failure_injection: prepare, commit, rollback, restore and capability-loss failures are injected and assert no partial publication.

entries.reason: All explicit debt has owner, issue, reason, expiry and zero net-growth budget; the existing gate remains authoritative.
entries.removal_condition: remove the debt entry when the corresponding migration or documentation is complete; expiry forces review before renewal.
